info.title: Loomwork HTTP API
info.description: JSON API the loomwork browser UI runs on, served by `loomwork serve` over loopback only. It is a handler layer over internal/store: every response document is a stored domain document, so this description doubles as the contract for scripts and agents that read a workspace without shelling out to the CLI. There is no authentication because the server is single-user, local-first, and never reachable from another host. API requests from unrelated browser origins are rejected with HTTP 403 before reading or writing workspace data.

servers.description: Default `loomwork serve` address; --addr changes the port.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.description: Free-form versioned project material: specs, logs, docs, generated content.

tags.name: test-suites
tags.description: Versioned test suites, generated or imported, audited for traceability.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Versioned agent definitions and the override rules that govern generation.

tags.name: desktop
tags.description: Project tree, typed viewers, version history, testability, model discovery, and streamed chat.

get.summary: This description of the API.

200.description: The OpenAPI document embedded in the binary.

get.summary: Liveness check.
Which workspace this server edits.
get.description: Lets a client show the workspace it is editing, so a UI opened against the wrong LOOMWORK_HOME is obvious.

get.summary: List configured text providers and their available models.
get.description: A provider discovery failure stays on that provider row and does not hide other configured providers. Configured default and preset-backed models remain selectable when live discovery is unavailable.

post.summary: Inspect a local project without storing it.
post.description: The spec-kit adapter reads numbered FR, NFR, and SC requirements and documentation under specs/, plus the constitution. Test Markdown is preserved, not converted or executed. Symbolic-link documents are not imported. Limits: 6 MB per document, 32 MB per snapshot, 2000 entries, 16 directory levels.

200.description: Feature counts and warnings; nothing is written.

post.summary: Create an independent local project snapshot.
post.description: Reads the selected features again and atomically publishes a new project. Duplicate project names are rejected. Imported requirements cannot be created, amended, versioned, or have status changed. Artifacts, test suites, agents, rules, and reports remain writable locally. The source directory is never modified. No export or synchronization is performed.

get.summary: Summarize every project.
get.description: Each row is built from the project document alone, including the counts the store caches, so listing many projects never scans their subfolders.

get.summary: List retained execution report files.

post.description: Accepts UTF-8 text up to 6 MB. Names are relative paths inside reports/. Existing files cannot be replaced. A .json file must contain valid JSON.

get.summary: Fetch one project document.
get.description: Returns metadata, document sources, cached counts, and artifacts.

get.summary: List a project's document source links.

post.summary: Attach or update a document source link.
post.description: Posting a source whose name already exists updates that link instead of duplicating it, matching the CLI.

get.summary: Read document-suite folder settings.

put.summary: Group copied QA folders as document suites.
put.description: Roots are non-overlapping project-relative folder prefixes without wildcards. Empty roots disables grouping. Spec-kit defaults to each imported feature's sdd-qa folder. No files are moved, fetched, or deleted; artifact IDs, versions, and requirement links stay intact. Document suites appear in the test-suites tree group with family document-suites and artifactType document-suite; they are not executable native suites and do not contribute to native coverage.

get.summary: List current test links for every requirement.
get.description: Derived on read from current suite cases and latest scenario artifacts. Native cases use requirement_ids. Scenario documents must have document_kind=test-scenario metadata or the test-scenario tag; explicit requirement_ids metadata and Markdown Purpose/Requirements/Covers fields are recognized. Imported spec-kit references also use FR filenames and frontmatter fr, matched within the same feature. Incidental prose and code-block references are ignored. Markdown links do not contribute to native test coverage or imply execution. Empty arrays mean no linked tests; these are current links, not historical execution records.

200.description: Requirement IDs mapped to test links.

get.summary: List the current version of every requirement.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only requirements whose current version has this status.

get.summary: Fetch one requirement version.

put.summary: Amend the current requirement version in place.
put.description: Rewrites the current version without changing its version, status, or creation timestamp. Fields left empty inherit from the current version. `status` is rejected — use the status endpoint to change a status.

patch.description: The new version is active and the previous one becomes superseded; earlier versions stay readable. `status` is rejected here — use the status endpoint to change a status.

get.summary: List every retained version, oldest first.

post.description: Changes a status in place rather than writing a new version, so marking a requirement obsolete does not invent history.

get.summary: Build the Agent Desktop entity tree.
get.description: Returns requirements, agent definitions, override rules, test suites and nested cases, report files, and latest free-form artifact revisions grouped by their project subfolder.

get.summary: Read one typed viewer document.
get.description: The artifactType and mediaType select the frontend viewer registry. Unknown values remain valid and use the raw fallback.

post.summary: Stream one assistant turn with Server-Sent Events.
post.description: The stream emits ready, message, done, or error events. Message data contains a delta field. This provider-neutral wire format remains stable when AgentAdapter streaming replaces the initial TextGenerator implementation.

get.summary: Derive the project's testability rollup.
get.description: Computed on read from the current test suite versions and the reports folder: which active requirements have a linked test case, which have none, and the outcome of the most recent report.

get.summary: List the latest revision of every artifact name.

200.description: Latest artifact revisions, ordered by name.

post.description: Posting an existing name writes the next revision with the previous one as its parent, matching `artifact add`. Only inline content is accepted: a browser cannot reference a path on the server's disk.

get.summary: List the current version of every test suite, manifest only.

200.description: Suite manifests without their cases; case_ids names them.

post.summary: Import a suite document as the next version of its suite id.
post.description: The body is the suite document itself (docs/schemas/test-case.schema.json), so a file that works with `test-suite import --file` posts unchanged. The suite is audited against the active override rules and requirements: unlinked cases or violated rules make it incomplete, and an incomplete suite is stored and flagged rather than rejected.

parameters.name: suiteId
parameters.description: Override the suite_id in the document.

201.description: The stored suite version and its audit.

get.summary: List the current version of every agent definition.

post.summary: Create an agent definition at version 1.
post.description: target_provider defaults to claude-agent-sdk. tools_allowed is a strict allowlist: a definition that names no tools grants none.

patch.summary: Write the next agent definition version.
patch.description: Fields left empty inherit from the current version, so a body-only edit keeps the target and tool allowlist. Earlier version files are never modified.

get.summary: List the current version of every override rule.

post.summary: Create an override rule at version 1.
post.description: A rule is hybrid: a structured condition/action pair the workbench audits deterministically plus the free-text rationale the agent reasons over. The rationale is required.

patch.summary: Write the next override rule version.
patch.description: The new version is active and the previous one becomes superseded. Fields left empty inherit from the current version.

post.summary: Set one rule version's status to active or obsolete.
post.description: superseded is set only by writing a newer version and is rejected here.

get.summary: List the retained versions of a versioned item, newest first.
get.description: Works for requirements, artifacts, agent-definitions, override-rules, and test-suites; other families are rejected with 400. Read a listed version's full document from the item endpoint with ?version=N. An artifact ID still selects that immutable revision when no version is specified.

ItemFamily.name: family
ItemFamily.description: Typed project subfolder or nested test-case family.

ItemRef.name: itemRef
ItemRef.description: Entity id or name. Test-case refs use suite-id~case-id.

Version.name: version
Version.description: Retained version to read. Omitted means the current version.

AgentName.name: agentName
AgentName.description: Agent definition name, stable across versions.

RuleID.name: ruleId
RuleID.description: Override rule id, stable across versions.

BadRequest.description: The request was rejected: an unparseable body, an unknown field, or a value the domain refused.

NotFound.description: No such endpoint, project, or requirement version.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The desktop provider service was not configured.

DocumentSuite.description: A derived collection of current QA documents, returned as the body of a document-suites viewer item. Individual documents retain their artifact IDs and version history.

ref.description: Item reference: suite~tc-id for a native case, artifact ID for a scenario document.

path.description: Absolute source directory on the server machine.

name.description: Local project name; defaults to the source directory name.

features.description: Feature directory names. Omitted or empty selects all features.

projectsDir.description: Directory holding one folder per project.

artifactRefs.description: Optional artifact ids or names to attach as grounding context.

sources.description: Document source links to attach as part of creation.

ProjectIndex.description: Counts the store caches in the project document so a landing view need not scan subfolders.

Testability.description: Per-project health rollup derived on read from the current test suite versions and the reports folder. `available` is false when the project has no suites and no reports, so a client can tell "nothing tested yet" from "0% covered"; coverage and gaps are null until at least one suite and one active requirement exist.

lastTestedAt.description: Run timestamp of the newest report when it records one, otherwise the file's modification time.

coveragePercent.description: Share of active requirements linked by at least one test case.

openGaps.description: Active requirements with no linked test case.

TestabilityReport.description: The rollup plus the requirement ids behind it and the newest report's outcome.

RunSummary.description: Aggregate counts read from the newest JSON report. Counts nested under `summary` (api-test-runner) or at the top level are accepted; otherwise per-row `results`/`tests` statuses are tallied.

report.description: Report path relative to the project's reports folder.

ItemVersion.description: One retained version of a versioned item.

status.description: Family-specific: requirement or rule status, or ready/incomplete for a suite.

summary.description: Short human-readable label for the version.

mediaType.description: Overrides the media type inferred from the name's extension.

DocumentSource.description: A link to documentation a requirement can cite. Loomwork stores the link, not the document.

Artifact.description: Immutable, versioned unit of project material. Metadata such as tags and the pinned flag may change; the body never does.

pinned.description: Pinned artifacts form the standing context supplied to prompt runs.

parentId.description: Artifact this one was derived from.

ArtifactBody.description: Carries either inline content or an external reference, never both.

SourceType.description: System of record for the originating documentation.

RequirementStatus.description: Whether a requirement version is still testable. Superseded and obsolete versions are retained for audit rather than deleted.

RequirementOrigin.description: How a requirement version was produced.

RequirementWrite.description: The writable half of a requirement: the stored document minus id, version, and created_at, which the store assigns. Empty fields take domain defaults on create and inherit from the current version on update.

source_ref.description: Requires source_type; a reference without a system of record is rejected.

RequirementUpdate.description: The fields of a new requirement version. Fields left empty inherit from the current version, and `status` is rejected: an update always writes an active version.

Requirement.description: One immutable version snapshot, as stored in requirements/<id>.v<version>.json. The full constraints live in docs/schemas/requirement.schema.json.

display_id.description: Spec reference for a legacy import; both this reference and the stored id resolve to the same history.

version.description: Version to change. 0 or omitted changes the current version.

TestScenario.description: Closed set so an override rule's condition and a generated case match mechanically.

TestExpectation.description: Structural only: value-level comparison is out of scope.

TestCase.description: One REST API test case. requirement_ids and overrides_applied are always present so an unlinked case is visible in the document. Stored cases always carry an id; an import may omit it. Full constraints: docs/schemas/test-case.schema.json.

id.description: Assigned in tc-NNN order when omitted on import.

overrides_applied.description: Override rule citations in rule-id-vN form.

TestSuiteImport.description: A suite document authored outside Loomwork (docs/schemas/test-case.schema.json). Unknown fields are rejected. The store assigns version, origin, and created_at; case ids left empty are assigned in tc-NNN order.

TestSuite.description: One immutable suite version as stored. List responses omit cases and name them in case_ids.

incomplete.description: True when a case is unlinked, a rule is violated, or a link points at an unknown requirement.

TestSuiteAudit.description: What auditing the suite against the override rules found. Annotations changed the stored suite; the other kinds made it incomplete.

AgentTarget.description: Agent adapter backend. copilot-sdk is declared but has no adapter yet.

AgentDefinitionWrite.description: The writable half of an agent definition. agent_name is required on create and ignored on update; empty fields inherit on update.

AgentDefinition.description: One immutable version, stored as agent-definitions/<agent_name>.v<version>.md. Full constraints: docs/schemas/agent-definition.schema.json.

OverrideCondition.description: Selects the cases a rule governs; every populated field must match and an empty condition matches every case.

path_pattern.description: Glob: * stays within one segment, ** crosses segments.

spec_status.description: The literal spec status the rule corrects; documentary, not matched.

expect_status.description: Required for expect-status, defaults to 200 for expect-empty-collection, forbidden for skip-test.

OverrideRuleWrite.description: The writable half of an override rule. id is required on create and ignored on update; empty fields inherit on update. A rationale is required because the agent reasons over it.

OverrideRule.description: One immutable rule version, stored as agent-definitions/override-rules/<id>.v<version>.json.

version.description: Version to change. 0 or omitted changes the current version.
